# HordeLedger

> Auction house prices and market analysis for World of Warcraft: WoW Forever, US PvP, Horde. Updated hourly from Blizzard's Game Data API. Every item page states the current market price, cheapest listing, units listed, 7-day range, estimated sales per day, best hours to sell (US Central) and a posting tip, in plain text.

Data last updated 2026-11-14 5:00 US Central. Money is gold (g), silver (s) and copper (c); 1g = 100s = 10000c. "Market price" is the average unit price of the cheapest 25% of units listed. Prices are for one realm's Horde auction house; other realms differ. Fan project, not affiliated with Blizzard.

## Main pages
- [Market dashboard](https://hordeledger.com/market/): every listed item, searchable and sortable
- [Crafting materials](https://hordeledger.com/materials/): the busiest herbs, ores, bars, cloth, leather and enchanting materials with 14-day trends
- [Prices by category](https://hordeledger.com/items/): herbs, ore, cloth, leather, ammo, consumables, recipes and more
- [Blog](https://hordeledger.com/blog/): market analysis
- [About and method](https://hordeledger.com/about/): data sources, how numbers are calculated, privacy

## Data
- [market.csv](https://hordeledger.com/data/market.csv): current price table for all listed items (copper)

## Blog posts
- [Smelting Pays More the Higher the Skill Gate](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-13-smelting-pays-more-the-higher-the-skill-gate/): Thorium Bar clears about 7s over Thorium Ore after the auction cut; copper and tin clear nothing. Smelting margins on the Horde AH, by skill level.
- [Five Cheap Staples Repriced Overnight](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-12-five-cheap-staples-repriced-overnight/): Small Venom Sac, Fish Bowl, Elemental Water and two more jumped 3x to 1,900x in one night on the Horde AH. Which moves are holding and which aren't.
- [Silk, Heavy Leather and Iron Bar Hit the Vendor Floor](https://hordeledger.com/blog/2026-11-11-silk-heavy-leather-iron-bar-hit-the-vendor-floor/): Iron Bar, Silk Cloth and Heavy Leather are down about 90% since launch and now trade within 20-30% of vendor price: little downside left for crafters.
- [The first 72 hours of the Horde auction house](https://hordeledger.com/blog/launch-week/): We watched one WoW Forever auction house from launch night on. Prices halved, ammo ran a third of all volume, and most listings that vanish come straight back cheaper. Ten things that stood out.
